name: Western Metal Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Western Metal Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of rare metal materials and its alloys in China and internationally. The company offers titanium, zirconium, and its alloy products comprising ingots, slabs, forgings, hot-rolled medium and heavy plates, cold-rolled sheets, strips, and pipes, as well as processed zirconium, nickel, and steel products for use in the aviation, aerospace, marine, weaponry, energy, and chemical industries; layered metal composite materials consisting of titanium/steel composite plates, zirconium/steel composite plates, tantalum/steel composite plates, nickel/steel composite plates, and co…
